source.place: Section Tag 01F7 (section-functoriality): Lemma Tag 01F8 (lemma-functoriality) and Remark Tag 01FB, written for ringed spaces; for sites the same construction with f_* = u^s (sites-cohomology.tex Remark Tag 08J6 remark-before-Leray); universality of the delta-functor H^*(V,-): derived.tex Lemma Tag 015B (lemma-higher-derived-functors) (4)

proof.text: Use injectivity of evaluation at the free generator in degree zero. Induct on the degree. Embed the coefficient sheaf in an injective and take its cokernel. Positive Ext into the injective vanishes, so the connecting map is surjective. Lift a class through this map, use compatibility of both families with the boundary, and use induction on the cokernel.
